title: Biliteracy Foundations for Teaching and Learning in Diverse Communities
description: Oral, written, and communicative competencies in Spanish through practical experiences and study of sociopolitical and sociocultural contexts impacting bilingual learners in culturally and linguistically diverse communities.

title: Biliteracy Foundations for Teaching and Learning in Diverse Communities Field Experience
description: Field experience in multilingual (Spanish-English) K-12 schools and communities.

title: Experimental Topics
description: Selected topics.

title: Special Study
description: Individual study.

title: Multilingual Education: Theory and Practice for Biliteracy Teachers
description: Pedagogical and programmatic practices for addressing linguistic and academic needs of multilingual learners. Historical and theoretical foundations of bilingual education as related to bilingual and dual language programs to include instruction, curriculum, and assessment.

title: Psychological Foundations for Biliteracy Teachers in K-6 Classrooms
description: Major theories of learning and cognition as applied to bilingual students and their relation to child development, first and second language acquisition, and approaches to teaching in bilingual classroom.

title: Psychological Foundations for Biliteracy Teachers in Grades 7-12
description: Bilingual learning theory as it affects adolescent growth, individualized instruction, classroom management and discipline, and methods of measuring and evaluating achievement.
notes: Taught in Spanish and English. See

title: Biliteracy Teaching in Language Arts for Elementary Students
description: Assessing language proficiency; selecting, designing, and evaluating learning experiences to develop biliteracy in K-6 classrooms in English language arts and language of emphasis (Arabic, Mandarin, or Spanish).
notes: Taught bilingually in language of emphasis and English.

title: Language Assessment and Evaluation in Multicultural Settings
description: Theories and methods of assessment and evaluation of diverse student populations including authentic and traditional models. Procedures for identification, placement, and monitoring of linguistically diverse students. Theories, models, and methods for program evaluation, achievement, and decision making.

title: Special Topics in Bilingual and Multicultural Education
description: Selected topics in bilingual, cross-cultural education and policy studies.

title: Foundations of Democratic Schooling
description: Analysis of relationships among ideology, culture, and power in educational context; key concepts in critical pedagogy applied to programs, curricula, and school restructuring.

title: Foundations of Dual Language Programming for Critical Biliteracy Development
description: Critical literacy and democratic schooling for dual language program models. Program models that apply to policies and practices that inform literacy curriculum and pedagogy in dual language-biliteracy settings.

title: Language Policies and Practices
description: Formal and informal policies related to education of linguistically diverse students at micro/macro level and in school contexts; analysis of bilingual and cross-cultural issues in cognition and literacy.

title: Community and Schools in a Diverse Society
description: Linguistic and cultural diversity of school and community. Development of community sociocultural scan; home and school collaboration; effects of home and school collaboration on achievement; responsibility of parent caretaker, stakeholder for student success.

title: Learning and Teaching Language in a Dual Language Setting
description: Dual language instructional methods, modeling oral and written grammatical structures. Language acquisition strategies for English and Spanish in K-12 grades. Emphasis on written structures for academic literacy.

title: Curriculum Development for Urban School Communities via Action Research
description: Curriculum development through lens of critical theory and action research. Principles of curriculum, instruction, and programs contextualized and with regard to particular educational institutions or work sites from a social justice perspective.

title: ELD Curriculum, Teaching, and Assessment
description: Methods in teaching English language development (ELD). Delivery of comprehensive instruction and assessment for English learners. Strategies for implementing state adopted standards for ELD in language and content areas. Review of current policy and research on education for multilingual English learners.

title: Literacy and Language: Critically Examining Curriculum for Teaching and Learning
description: Research in literacy and multicultural curriculum theories, methods, and teaching connected to community, school, and personal literacies. Literacy practices for educating diverse students; varying definitions of literacy and social-political contexts of literacy curriculum.

title: Language Development Multilingual Classrooms
description: Dual language and multilingual classrooms, universals and differences in language structure, transfer, and use (including basic linguistics). First and additional language development; related factors (political/sociocultural aspects of bilingualism).

title: Seminar in Multicultural Education
description: Topics dealing with current issues in multicultural education.

title: Special Study
description: May involve fieldwork.

title: Teaching Mathematics to Bilingual Students
description: Underlying learning theories for teaching mathematical concepts, computation, and problem-solving skills to bilingual students.

title: Teaching Social Studies to Bilingual Students
description: Conceptual approaches for teaching bilingual social studies curriculum, incorporating sociocultural characteristics of multicultural community, social concepts, and community social issues.

title: Teaching Science to Bilingual Students
description: Strategies for development of process skills and concept acquisition. Methodology for teaching activity-oriented science class bilingually.

title: Teaching and Learning in the Content Area: Designated and Integrated English Language Development-Multiple Subject
description: Teaching strategies in content specific fields from second language acquisition perspective.
notes: See Class Schedule for specific content

title: Teaching and Learning in the Content Area: Designated and Integrated English Language Development-Single Subject
description: Teaching strategies in content specific fields from second language acquisition perspective.
notes: See Class Schedule for specific content

title: Intern Seminar: Teaching English Learners
description: Research-based instruction to meet the needs of diverse language learners in a variety of classroom settings.

title: Skills in Teaching Reading to Bilingual Elementary Students
description: Teaching reading in English, including methods, strategies, assessment, materials, and techniques of transition for implementing reading programs in the bilingual classroom.

title: Skills in Teaching Reading to Bilingual Secondary Students
description: Methods for developing reading skills in Spanish and English across subject areas. Includes comprehension, academic vocabulary, concept development, reading strategies, and assessment.

title: Classroom Organization for Democratic Teaching in Bilingual Classrooms
description: Teaching practices to include democratic processes for classroom management in bilingual classrooms. Classroom teaching, classroom discipline, and curriculum management. Social-cultural and political contexts of teaching to include overview of teacher performance assessment tasks.

title: Professional Seminar for Bilingual Teacher Candidates
description: Lesson planning and organizing instruction for equity and access for bilingual elementary and secondary classrooms.

title: Practicum in Elementary Bilingual Classroom
description: Field experience at two grade levels in a multicultural setting and a bilingual elementary classroom; student teacher assumes responsibility for planning and instruction for specified time to comply with State requirements.

title: Student Teaching for Elementary Bilingual Students II
description: Field experience in a multicultural setting or a bilingual elementary classroom. Student must provide own transportation to student teaching site.

title: Practicum in Secondary Bilingual Classroom
description: On-site, part-time to full-time experience to implement bilingual teacher competencies introduced in DLE 515, DLE 524, and DLE 954. Students must provide own transportation to student teaching site.

title: Student Teaching for Bilingual Secondary Students II
description: On-site, full-day experience in State approved bilingual and nonbilingual classes to implement teacher competencies as developed in the total professional sequence. Students must provide own transportation to student teaching site.
